G1801.def:
ἐνωτίζομαι
(οὖς), 
depon. mid., 
[in LXX chiefly for אָזַן hi. ;] 
to give ear to, hearken to: with accusative, Actes 2:14.†
Also used for יָחַל שָׁמַע

G1802.def:
Ἐνώχ (Heb. חֲנוֹךְ), ὁ, 
Enoch (Genèse 5:18): Luc 3:37, Hébreux 11:5, Ju 14.†

G1803.def:
ἕξ, οἱ, αἱ, τά
indecl., 
six: Matthieu 17:1, Luc 13:14, al.

G1804.def:
ἐξ-αγγέλλω 
[in LXX chiefly for סָפַר pi. ;] 
to tell out, proclaim: 1 Pierre 2:9 [Marc 16:1-20, "shorter conclusion"] (Cremer, 29).†

G1805.def:
ἐξ-αγοράζω 
[in LXX: καιρόν ὑμεῖς ἐξαγοράζετε (זְבַן), Dan LXX TH Daniel 2:8 * ;] 
__1. to redeem, ransom (esp. of slaves): metaphorically, Galates 3:13 4:5. 
__2. to buy up; mid., to buy up for oneself: τ. καιρόν, Éphésiens 5:16, Colossiens 4:5 (Cremer, 60).†

G1806.def:
ἐξ-άγω 
[in LXX chiefly for יָצָא hi. ;] 
to lead out: with accusative, Marc 15:20, Jean 10:3, Actes 5:19 7:36 16:37-39; before ἔξω, Luc 24:50; ἐκ, Actes 7:40 12:17 13:17, Hébreux 8:9; εἰς, Actes 21:38.†

G1807.def:
ἐξ-αιρέω -ῶ 
[in LXX chiefly for נָצַל hi. ;] 
to take out: with accusative, ὀφθαλμόν, Matthieu 5:29 18:9; mid. 
__(a) to take out for oneself, choose: Actes 26:17 (Thayer, see word; Page, Ac., l.with, but see infr.); 
__(b) to deliver: Actes 7:10, 34" (LXX) Actes 12:11 Actes 23:27 Actes 26:17 (EV, but see supr.), Galates 1:4.†

G1808.def:
ἐξ-αίρω 
[in LXX for נָסַע, יָרַשׁ hi., כָּרַת ni., מוּת, בָּעַר pi., etc. ;] 
to lift up, lift off the earth, remove: 1 Corinthiens 5:13 (LXX)†

G1809.def:
ἐξ-αιτέω, -ῶ 
to ask from; mid., to ask for oneself, demand: aor., ἐξῃτήσατο, with accusative (obtained you by asking, R, mg.), Luc 22:31 (see Field, Notes, 76; Cremer, 73).†

G1810.def:
ἐξ-αίφνης (WH, ἐξέφνης, exc. Actes 22:6; see App., p. 151, and cf. M, Pr., 35), adv. 
(ἄφνω), [in LXX chiefly for פִּתְאוֹם ;] 
suddenly Marc 13:36, Luc 2:13 9:39, Actes 9:3 22:6.†

G1811.def:
ἐξ-ακολουθέω, -ῶ 
[in LXX Amos 2:4, Jérémie 2:2 (אַחַר הָלַךְ), Ésaïe 56:11 (פָּנָה), Job 31:9 (פָּתָה ni.), Sir.5:2, Dan LXX TH Daniel 3:1-30 :(41) * ;] 
to follow, follow up (in various senses): metaphorically, 2 Pierre 1:16 2:2 2:15 †

G1813.def:
ἐξ-αλείφω 
[in LXX for טוּחַ, Lévitique 14:42, al.; metaphorically, מָחָה, שָׁחַת, etc. ;] 
__1. to plaster, wash over (LXX). 
__2. to wipe off, wipe out: δάκρυον, Apocalypse 7:17 21:4; metaphorically, χειρόγραφον, Colossiens 2:14; τ. ὄνομα, before ἐκ, Apocalypse 3:5 (MM, Exp., xiii); pass., ἀμαρτίαι (ἐξαλιφθῆναι, WH), Actes 3:19 (cf. Psaumes 51:11 Psaumes 109:13, Ésaïe 43:25, Sir.46:20 (ἁμ. ἀπαλ-), 3Ma.2:19).†

G1814.def:
ἐξ-άλλομαι 
[in LXX for קָלַל (Habacuc 1:8), etc. ;] 
to leap up: Actes 3:8.†

G1815.def:
ἐξ-ανάστασις, -εως, ἡ
(ἐξανίστημι), 
a rising again: ἐκ τ. νεκρῶν, Philippiens 3:11 (Cremer, 308).†

G1816.def:
ἐξ-ανα-τέλλω 
[in LXX: Genèse 2:9, Psaumes 104:14 Psaumes 132:17 Psaumes 147:8 (צָמַח hi.); Psaumes 112:4 (זָרַח) * ;] 
__1. trans., to cause to spring up (LXX). 
__2. Intrans. (as ἀνατέλλω, Genèse 3:18), to spring up: Matthieu 13:5, Marc 4:5.†

G1817.def:
ἐξ-ανίσημι 
[in LXX chiefly for קוּם ;] 
__1. trans., to raise up: σπέρμα (cf. Genèse 38:8), Marc 12:19, Luc 20:28. 
__2. In 2 aor. act., intrans., to rise: Actes 15:5.†

G1818.def:
ἐξ -απατάω, -ῶ strengthened form of ἀπατάω, 
[in LXX: Exode 8:29 (הָתַל hi.), Da TH Sus 5:6* ;] 
to deceive: with accusative, Romains 7:11 Romains 16:18, 1 Corinthiens 3:18, 2 Corinthiens 11:3, 2 Thessaloniciens 2:3; pass., 1 Timothée 2:14.†

G1819.def:
ἐξάπινα = ἐξαπίνης, ἐξαίφνης (which see), 
[in LXX for פִּתְאוֹם, etc. ;] 
suddenly: Marc 9:8.†

G1820.def:
ἐξ-απορέω, -ῶ 
[in LXX, pass., for פּוּן, Psaumes 88:15 * ;] 
so in NT, depon. pass., to be utterly at a loss, be in despair: absol. (as Ps, l.with), 2 Corinthiens 4:8; τοῦ ζῆν, 2 Corinthiens 1:8.†

G1821.def:
ἐξ-απο-στέλλω 
[in LXX freq., chiefly for שָׁלַח pi. ;] 
__1. to send forth: with accusative of person(s), Actes 7:12 12:11, Galates 4:4; τ. ἐπαγγελίαν, Luc 24:49; τ. πνεῦμα, Galates 4:6; [τ. κήρυγμα, Marc 16:1-20, "shorter conclusion," WH ;] before εἰς, Actes 22:21; pass., ὁ λόγος, Actes 13:26. 
__2. to send away: with accusative of person(s), before εἰς, Actes 9:30; before ἕως, Actes 11:22; with inf., Actes 17:14; κενόν, Luc 1:53 20:10-11.†

G1822.def:
ἐξ-αρτίζω
(ἄρτιος), [in LXX. Exode 28:7 (חָבַר pu.) * ;] 
__1. to com­plete, finish: τ. ἡμέρας, Actes 21:5. 
__2. to furnish, supply: pass., 2 Timothée 3:17 (for exx., see MM, Exp., xiii; Cremer, 651).†

G1823.def:
ἐξ-αστράπτω 
[in LXX: Nombres 3:3 (בָּרָק), Eze.1:4 (לָקַח hithp.) 17 Dan LXX 106 (קָלַל)* ;] 
to flash like lightning, gleam, be radiant: ἱματισμός, Luc 9:29.†

G1824.def:
ἐξ-αυτῆς
(a κοινή word, = ἐξ αὐτῆς τ. ὥρας) 
at once, forthwith: Marc 6:25, Actes 10:33 Actes 11:11 Actes 21:32 Actes 23:30, Philippiens 2:23.†

G1825.def:
ἐξ-εγείρω 
[in LXX for עוּר ni., hi., etc. ;] 
to raise up: Romains 9:17 (cf. ICC, in l); from the dead, 1 Corinthiens 6:14.†

G1826.def:
ἔξ-ειμι
(εἶμι), 
to go forth: Actes 13:42 Actes 17:15 Actes 20:7; before ἐπί, with accusative, Actes 27:43.†

G1828.def:
ἐξ-έλκω 
[in LXX: Genèse 37:28 (מָשַׁךְ), etc. ;] 
to draw out or away: metaphorically, ὑπὸ τ. ἐπιθυμίας, Jacques 1:14 (see Mayor, in l).†

G1829.def:
ἐξέραμα, -τος, τό
(ἐξεράω, to evacuate, disgorge) 
a vomit: 2 Pierre 2:22 (LXX).†

G1830.def:
ἐξ-εραυνάω
(Rec. ἐξερευνάω), -ῶ, [in LXX for חָקַר, נָצַר, etc. ;] 
to search out, search carefully: before περί, 1 Pierre 1:10.†

G1831.def:
ἐξέρχομαι, 
[in LXX chiefly and very frequently for יצא, also for עלה ,בּוֹא, etc. ;] depon., 
to go, or come out of: Matthieu 10:11, Marc 1:35, Jean 13:30, al.; with inf., Matthieu 11:8, Marc 3:21, Luc 7:25, 26 Actes 20:8; id. before ἐπί, Matthieu 26:55, al.; εἰς, Marc 1:38; ἵνα, Apocalypse 6:2; ἐ. before ἐκ (cl. with genitive loc.), Marc 5:2, Jean 4:30, al.; ἔξω, with genitive, Matthieu 21:17, Marc 14:68, Actes 16:13, Hébreux 13:13; ἀπό, Marc 11:12, Luc 9:5, Philippiens 4:15; ἐκεῖθεν, Matthieu 15:21, Marc 6:1, Luc 9:4, al.; of demons expelled, before ἐκ (ἀπό), with genitive of person(s), Marc 1:25, 26 5:8, Luc 4:35, al.; of prisoners released, Matthieu 5:26, Actes 16:40; ptcp., ἐξελθών, with indic., of verb of departure (cf. Dalman, Words, 20f.), Matthieu 8:32 15:21 24:1, Marc 16:8, Luc 22:39, Actes 12:9, 17 al. Metaphorical, 
__(a) of persons: 2 Corinthiens 6:17, 1 Jean 2:19; of birth or origin, Matthieu 2:6 (LXX), Hébreux 7:5 (cf . Genèse 35:11); of escape from danger, ἐκ τ. χειρὸς αὐτῶν, Jean 10:39; of public appearance, 1 Jean 4:1; 
__(b) of things: Matthieu 24:27; esp. of utterances, reports, proclamations: φωνή, Apocalypse 16:17 19:5; φήμη, Matthieu 9:26, Luc 4:14; ἀκοή, Marc 1:28; λόγος, Jean 21:23; δόγμα, Luc 2:1 (cf. δι-εξέρχομαι).

G1832.def:
ἔξ-εστι 
(εἰμί), 
impers. verb., 
it is permitted, lawful: Marc 2:24, Actes 8:37 (R, mg.), 1 Corinthiens 10:23; with inf., Matthieu 12:2, 10 12 14:4 15:26 19:3 22:17 27:6, Marc 3:4 12:14, Luc 6:2, 9 14:3, Jean 5:10; before accusative, Marc 2:26, Luc 6:4 20:22; with dative of person(s) and inf., Matthieu 20:15, Marc 6:18 10:2, Jean 18:31, Actes 16:21 21:37 22:25 (inf. understood), 1 Corinthiens 6:12; ἐξόν (sc. ἐστί), Actes 2:29, 2 Corinthiens 12:4; ἐξὸν ἦν, Matthieu 12:4.†

G1833.def:
ἐξ-ετάζω
(ἐτάζω (rare), to examine), [in LXX: Deutéronome 13:14-15 Deutéronome 19:18, 1 Chroniques 28:9 A (דָּרַשׁ), דָּרַשׁ), Psaumes 11:5-6 (בָּחַן), Wis.6:3, Sir.3:21, al. ;] 
to examine closely, inquire carefully (of ): before περί (with ἀκριβῶς), Matthieu 2:8; before τίς, Matthieu 10:11; with accusative of person(s), Jean 21:12.†
SYN.: ἀνακρίνω, ἐραυνάω (see DCG, ii, 594b)

G1834.def:
ἐξ-ηγέομαι, -οῦμαι 
[in LXX chiefly for סָפַר pi. ;] 
to lead, show the way; metaphorically, to unfold, narrate, declare: with accusative of thing(s), Luc 24:35 Actes 21:19; with dative of person(s), Actes 10:8; θεόν (understood), Jean 1:18; before ὅσα, Actes 15:12; καθώς, Actes 15:14.†

G1835.def:
ἑξήκοντα, οἱ, αἱ, τά
indecl., 
sixty: Matthieu 13:8, 23, Marc 4:8, 20, Luc 24:13, 1 Timothée 5:9, Apocalypse 11:3 Apocalypse 12:6 Apocalypse 13:18.†

G1836.def:
ἑξῆς 
adv. (ἔχω), 
in order, successively, next: τῇ ἑ. ἡμέρᾳ, Luc 9:37; ἐν τῷ ἑ. (sc. χρόνῳ), soon after, Luc 7:11; τῇ ἑ. (sc. ἡμέρα), Actes 21:1 Actes 25:17 Actes 27:18.†

G1837.def:
ἐξ-ηχέω, -ῶ 
[in LXX: Joël 3:14 (הָמוֹן), Sir.40:13, 3Ma.3:2 * ;] 
to sound forth (as a trumpet, or thunder; see M, Th., l.with): pass., 1 Thessaloniciens 1:8.†

G1838.def:
ἐξις, -εως, ἡ
(ἔχω), [in LXX, cf. Sir, prol.9 ;] 
habit, use, experience: Hébreux 5:14.†

G1840.def:
ἐξ-ισχύω 
[in LXX: Sir.7:6 * ;] 
to have strength enough, to be quite able: with inf., Éphésiens 3:18.†

G1841.def:
ἔξ-οδος, -ου, ὁ
(ὁδός), [in LXX chiefly for מוֹצָא also חוּץ, etc. ;] 
a going out, departure: Hébreux 11:22; of death, Luc 9:31, 2 Pierre 1:15.†

G1842.def:
έξ-ολεθρεύω
(so best MSS. and WH; also read -οθρεύω), [in LXX frequently (rare in Gk. writers) for כָּרַת ni., hi., etc. ;] 
to destroy utterly: before ἐκ τ. λαοῦ, Actes 3:23 (LXX).†

G1843.def:
ἐξ-ομολογέω, -ῶ and depon. mid., -έομαι, -οῦμαι 
[as always in LXX chiefly for יָדָה hi. ;] 
__1. act. = cl. ὁμολογέω, to profess or agree to do (Field, Notes, 75): Luc 22:6. 
__2. Mid., to acknowledge, confess (MM, Exp., xiv): τ. ἁμαρτίας, Matthieu 3:6, Marc 1:5, Jacques 5:16; τ. πράξεις, Actes 19:18; before ὅτι, Philippiens 2:11; with dative of person(s), to make acknowledgment to one's honour, to praise, give praise to (as in LXX; Kennedy, Sources, 118): Romains 14:11(LXX) Romains 15:9 (LXX); before ὅτι, Matthieu 11:25, Luc 10:21 (Cremer, 771).†

G1844.def:
ἐξ-ορκίζω
(later form of ἐξορκόω ), [in LXX: Juges 17:2 (אָלָה), Genèse 24:3, 3Ki.22:16 (שָׁבַע hi.)* ;] 
__1. to administer an oath to (Dem., Polyb., al.). 
__2. to adjure: with accusative of person(s), before κατά, with genitive (as frequently in magic π.; MM, Exp., xiv), Matthieu 26:63.†

G1845.def:
ἐξ-ορκιστής, -οῦ, ὁ
(ἐξορκίζω), 
__1. one who administers an oath. 
__2. an exorcist: Actes 19:13.†

G1846.def:
ἐξ-ορύσσω 
[in LXX: Proverbes 29:22; ὀφθαλμόν (-ούς), Juges 16:21, 1 Rois 11:2 (נָקַר)* ;] 
to dig out, dig up: στέγην, Marc 2:4; metaphorically, ὀφοαλμούς (cf. LXX, ll with; Herod., viii, 116), Galates 4:15.†

G1847.def:
ἐξ-ουδενέω
(Rec. -όω; T, -θανόω), -ῶ, [in LXX (with vv. ll. -όω, -θενέω, -θενόω) for בּוּז, בָּזָה, מָאַס, בּוּס, etc. ;] 
to despise, set at nought: Marc 9:12 (cf. ἐξουθενέω).†

G1848.def:
ἐξ-ουθενέω, -ῶ
(οὐθείς, which see), [in LXX (see: ἐξουθενέω): 1 Rois 2:30, al., and as seel. for -δενέω, -όω, -θενόω* ;] 
to set at nought, despise utterly, treat with contempt: with accusative of person(s), Luc 18:9 23:11, Romains 14:3, 10, 1 Corinthiens 16:11; with accusative of thing(s), Galates 4:14, 1 Thessaloniciens 5:20; pass., of persons: Marc 9:12 (T, -όω), 1 Corinthiens 6:4; of things λίθος, Actes 4:11 (LXX ἀπεδοκίμασαν); λόγος, 2 Corinthiens 10:10; τὰ ἐξουθενημένα, 1 Corinthiens 1:28.†
SYN.: ἀθετέω, καταφρονέω (see DCG, i, 453b)

G1849.def:
ἐξουσία, -ας, ἡ 
(ἔξεστι), [in LXX: 4Ki.20:13, Psa.113 (114):2 135 (136)8, 9, Ésaïe 39:2, Jer.28 (51):28 (מֶמְשָׁלָה), frequently in Da for Aram. שָׁלְטָן, etc., Wis.10:14, Sir.9:13, al. ;] 
__1. prop., liberty or power to act, freedom to exercise the inward force or faculty expressed by δύναμις (which see): 1 Corinthiens 9:12; ἐ. ἔχειν, 2 Thessaloniciens 3:9; id. before inf., Jean 10:18, 1 Corinthiens 9:4, 5; with genitive obj., Romains 9:21; before ἐπί, with accusative, Apocalypse 22:14; περί, 1 Corinthiens 7:37. 
__2. Later (cf. Milligan, Th., 114; MM, Exp., xiv), of the power of right, authority: Matthieu 21:33, Marc 11:28, Luc 20:2; of Messianic authority, Matthieu 9:6, Marc 2:10, al.; of apostolic authority, 2 Corinthiens 10:8 13:10; of the authority of government: Matthieu 8:9 28:18, Ju 25, Apocalypse 12:10, al.; esp. of judicial authority, Luc 20:20, Jean 19:10, 11. 
__3. Meton., 
__(a) jurisdiction: Luc 23:7 (cf. 1Ma.6:11, Ésaïe 39:2); 
__(b) a ruler or magistrate: Romains 13:1-3; pl., Luc 12:11, Romains 13:1, Tite 3:1; 
__(with) of supramundane powers (syn. with ἀρχή, δύναμις, θρόνος, κυριότης): 1 Corinthiens 15:24, Éphésiens 1:21 3:10, Colossiens 2:10, 1 Pierre 3:22, al. (Cremer. 236). 
SYN.: see: δύναμις.

G1850.def:
ἐξουσιάζω
(ἐξουσία) [in LXX (frequently in Ec) chiefly for שָׁלַט ;] 
__1. to exercise authority (Arist.). 
__2. Trans., to exercise authority over: with genitive of person(s), Luc 22:25; with genitive of thing(s), 1 Corinthiens 7:4; pass., to be held under authority (see Lft., Notes, 214): before ὑπό, 1 Corinthiens 6:12.†

G1851.def:
ἐξοχή, -ῆς, ἡ 
(ἐξέχω, to stand out), [in LXX for שֵׁן, Job 39:28 * ;] 
__1. a projection (ἐ. πέτρας, Job 39:28). 
__2. Metaphorical, eminence, excellence: οἱ κατ᾽ ἐ., the chief men, Actes 25:23.†

G1852.def:
ἐξ-υπνίζω 
[in LXX: Juges 16:14, 20, 3Ki.3:13 (יָקַץ), Job 14:12 (עוּר ni.)* ;] 
to awaken out of sleep (= ἀφυπνίζω): with accusative of person(s), Jean 11:11.†

G1853.def:
ἔξ-υπνος, -ον
(ὕπνος), [in LXX: I Esther 3:3 * ;] 
roused out of sleep: Actes 16:27.†

G1855.def:
ἔξωθεν 
adv. (ἔξω opposite to ἔσωθεν), [in LXX for חוּץ ;] 
__1. prop. (in answer to the question, Whence ?), from without: Marc 7:18 
__2. More often (= ἔξω; cf. Bl., § 25, 3), without: Matthieu 23:27-28 Marc 7:18, 2 Corinthiens 7:5; τὸ ἔ., Matthieu 23:25, Luc 11:39-40; οἱ ἔ., 1 Timothée 3:7, Marc 4:11 (WH, mg.); ὁ ἔ. κόσμος, 1 Pierre 3:3; ἐκβάλλειν ἔ., Apocalypse 11:2. As prep. with genitive: Marc 7:15, Apocalypse 11:1-19 4Ki.14:20 (cf. Robertson, Gr., 548).†

G1856.def:
ἐξ-ωθέω, -ῶ 
[in LXX chiefly for נָדָה hi. ;] 
__1. to thrust out: Actes 7:45. 
__2. to drive out of the sea, drive on shore: Actes 27:39 (WH, txt., ἐκσῶσαι).†
*ἐκ-σώζω, 
to preserve from danger, bring safe: Actes 27:39 (ἐξῶσαι, WH, mg., R, txt., see: ἐξωθέω).†
ἐξ-ωθέω, -ῶ 
[in LXX chiefly for נָדָה hi. ;] 
__1. to thrust out: Actes 7:45. 
__2. to drive out of the sea, drive on shore: Actes 27:39 (WH, txt., ἐκσῶσαι).†
*ἐκ-σώζω, 
to preserve from danger, bring safe: Actes 27:39 (ἐξῶσαι, WH, mg., R, txt., see: ἐξωθέω).†

G1857.def:
ἐξώτερος, -α, -ον
(compar., from ἔξω; opposite to ἐσώτερος) [in LXX chiefly for חִיצוֹן ;] 
outer: σκότος, Matthieu 8:12 Matthieu 22:13 Matthieu 25:30.†

G1858.def:
ἑορτάζω
(ἑορτή), [in LXX for חָגַג ;] 
to keep festival: 1 Corinthiens 5:8.†

G1859.def:
ἑορτή, -ῆς, ἡ 
[in LXX for חַג (chiefly), מוֹעֵד ;] 
a feast, festival: Luc 2:42, Jean 5:1, Jean 6:4 Jean 7:37, Colossiens 2:10; ἡ ἑ. τοῦ πάσχα, Luc 2:41, Jean 13:1; τ. ἀζύμων, Luc 22:1; ἡ σκηνοπηγία, Jean 7:2 (Deiss., LAE, 116); ἐν τ. ἑ., Matthieu 26:5, Marc 14:2, Jean 4:45 7:11 12:20 (εἶναι ἐν ἑ.), Jean 2:23; εἰς τ. ἑ. (for the feast), Jean 13:29; ἀναβαίνειν, ἔρχεσθαι εἰς τ. ἑ., Jean 4:45 7:8-10 11:56 12:12; τῆς ἐ μεσούσης, Jean 7:14; κατὰ ἑ. (at each feast), Matthieu 27:15, Marc 15:6, Luc 23:17, R, mg.; τ. ἑ. ποιεῖν, Actes 18:21; κατὰ τὸ ἔθος τῆς ἑ., Luc 2:42.†

G1860.def:
ἐπ-αγγελία, -ας, ἡ
(ἐπαγγέλλω), [in LXX: Psaumes 56:8 (סֵפֶר), etc. ;] 
__1. a summons (as Attic law-term, Dem., al.). 
__2. a promise (Dem., Arist., al.): Actes 23:21; esp. in NT of the divine promises, Actes 7:17, Romains 4:14, 16 Romains 9:4, Galates 3:17-18, 21 4:23, Hébreux 8:6 11:9, 17, 2 Pierre 3:9; with inf., Hébreux 4:1; γίνεται, etc., with dative of person(s), Actes 2:39, Romains 4:13, Galates 3:16; before πρός, Actes 13:32 26:6; έπαγγέλεσθαι τὴν ἐ., 1 Jean 2:25; ἔχειν ἐπαγγελίας, Hébreux 7:6, 2 Corinthiens 7:1; εἷναι νἐ έπαγγελίᾳ, Éphésiens 6:2; ἡ γῆ τῆς ἐ., Hébreux 11:9; τὰ τέκνα τῆς ἐ., Romains 9:8, Galates 4:28; τ. πνεῦμα τῆς ἐ. τ. ἅγιον, Éphésiens 1:13; αἱ διαθῆκαι τῆς ἐ., Éphésiens 2:12; ἡ ἐ. τ. θεοῦ, Romains 4:20; pl., 2 Corinthiens 1:20; αἱ ἐ. τ. πατέρων, Romains 15:8; with genitive obj., τ. ζωῆς (see Dalman, Words, 103), 1 Timothée 4:8; τ. παρουσίας αὐτοῦ, 2 Pierre 3:4; κατ ̓ ἐπαγγελίαν, Actes 13:23, Galates 3:29, 2 Timothée 1:1; δι ̓ ἐπαγγελίας, Galates 3:18; συμμέτοχα τῆς ἐ., Éphésiens 3:6; λόγος ἐπαγγελίας, Romains 9:9. By meton. (cf. ἐλπίς), of a promised blessing: Luc 24:49, Actes 1:14, Galates 3:22, Hébreux 6:12-17 10:36 11:13, 33 11:39; with genitive epexeg., Actes 2:33 Galates 3:14, Hébreux 9:15 (Cremer, 27).†

G1863.def:
ἐπ-άγω 
[in LXX for בּוֹא hi., etc. (29 words in all) ;] 
to bring upon: with dative and accusative, 2 Pierre 2:5; ἑαυτοῖς ἐ. (for cl. mid., see Mayor, in l), 2 Pierre 2:1; ἐ. τὸ αἷμα (cf. Ge 209), Actes 5:28.†

G1865.def:
ἐπ-αθροίζω 
to assemble besides (Plut.): pass., Luc 11:29.†

G1866.def:
Ἐπαίνετος (Rec. -τός), -ου, ὁ 
Epænetus, a Christian of Borne: Romains 16:5.†

G1867.def:
ἐπ-αινέω, -ῶ 
[in LXX for הָלַל pi., שָׁבַח pi. ;] 
to praise: with accusative, Romains 15:11, 1 Corinthiens 11:22; before ὅτι, Luc 16:8, 1 Corinthiens 11:2; absol., before ὅτι, 1 Corinthiens 11:17.†

G1868.def:
ἔπ-αινος, -ου, ὁ 
[in LXX for תְּהִלָּה, etc. ;] 
praise: Romains 2:29 Romains 13:3, 1 Corinthiens 4:5, 2 Corinthiens 8:18, Éphésiens 1:6, 12 1:14, Philippiens 1:11 Philippiens 4:8, 1 Pierre 1:7 2:14.†

G1869.def:
ἐπ-αίρω 
[in LXX for נָשָׂא, רוּם, etc. ;] 
to lift up, raise: τ. ἀρτέμονα, Actes 27:40; χεῖρας, Luc 24:50, 1 Timothée 2:8; κεφαλάς, Luc 21:28; ὀφθαλμούς, Matthieu 17:8, Luc 6:20 16:23 18:13, Jean 4:35 6:5 17:1; φωνήν, Luc 11:27, Actes 2:14 14:11 22:22; τ. πτέρναν (figuratively), Jean 13:18. Pass., Actes 1:9; metaphorically, to be lifted up with pride: 2 Corinthiens 10:5 11:20.†

G1870.def:
ἐπ-αισχύνομαι 
[in LXX: Job 34:19 (נָשָׂא), Psaumes 119:6 (בּוּשׁ), Ésaïe 1:29 A (חָפֵר) * ;] 
to be ashamed (of): absol., 2 Timothée 1:12; with accusative of person(s), Marc 8:38, Luc 9:26; with accusative of thing(s), Romains 1:16, 2 Timothée 1:8 1:16; ἐπί, with dative of thing(s), Romains 6:21; with inf., Hébreux 2:11; with, accusative of person(s), and inf., Hébreux 11:16,†

G1871.def:
ἐπ-αιτέω, -ῶ, [in LXX: Psa_109:10 (H7592) Sir_40:28 * ;]
__1. to ask besides. 
__2. to beg (as a mendicant; cf. MM, Exp., xiv): Luc 16:3 18:35 (Cremer, 74).†

G1872.def:
ἐπ-ακολουθέω, -ῶ 
[in LXX (chiefly metaphorically) for אָחַר, הָלַךְ, etc. ;] 
to follow after; in NT metaphorically; absol.: Marc 16:20 (illustrated by use in verifying accounts; see MM, Exp., xiv; Milligan; NTD, 78); with dative of person(s), of sins, 1 Timothée 5:24 (cf. Ellic. and CGT, in l); τ. ἴχνεσιν, 1 Pierre 2:21; ἔργῳ ἀγαθῷ, 1 Timothée 5:10.†

G1873.def:
ἐπ-ακούω 
[in LXX for שָׁמַע, עָנָה, etc. ;] 
__1. to listen to. 
__2. to hearken to, hear with favour (one's prayer): with genitive of person(s), 2 Corinthiens 6:2 (LXX).†

G1874.def:
ἐπ-ακροάομαι, -ῶμαι 
to listen attentively: Actes 16:25 (cf. Page, in l).†

G1875.def:
ἐπ-άν 
conj. (ἐπεί, which see, ἄν) 
later form of ἐπήν, 
after, when: with subjc. Pres., Luc 11:34; with subjc. aor., Matthieu 2:8, Luc 11:22.†

G1876.def:
ἐπανάγκης, -ες
(ἀνάγκη), only in neut.; 
__1. ἐπάναγκες (sc. ἐστί), it is compulsory, necessary. 
__2. As adv., of necessity: Actes 15:28.†

G1877.def:
ἐπ-αν-άγω 
[in LXX: Zacharie 4:12 (רוּק hi.), Sir.17:26 26:28, 2Ma.9:21 2Mac 12:4 * ;] 
to bring up or back (sc. ναῦς); to put out to sea (DB, iii, 63b): Luc 5:3-4; intrans., to return: Matthieu 21:18.†

G1878.def:
ἐπ-ανα-μιμνήσκω 
to remind again: with accusative of person(s), Romains 15:15.†

G1879.def:
ἐπ-ανα-παύω 
[in LXX, mid., for נוּחַ, שָׁעַן ni ;] 
to refresh, cause to rest (upon); mid., to rest upon: metaphorically, with dative, Romains 2:17; before ἐπί, with accusative, Luc 10:6 (Cremer, 827).†

G1880.def:
ἐπ-αν-έρχομαι 
[in LXX for שׁוּב, etc. ;] 
to return: Luc 10:35 19:15.†

G1881.def:
ἐπ-αν-ίστημι 
[in LXX chiefly for קוּם ;] 
to raise up against; mid., to rise up against: before ἐπί, with accusative of person(s), Matthieu 10:21, Marc 13:12.†

G1882.def:
ἐπ-αν-όρθωσις, -εως, ἡ
(ἐπανορθόω, to correct, restore; of. 2Ma.2:22) [in LXX: I Esther 8:52, 1Ma.14:34 * ;] 
correction: of life, 2 Timothée 3:16 (cf. MM, Exp., xiv).†

G1884.def:
ἐπ-αρκέω, -ῶ 
[in LXX: 1Ma.8:26 1Mac 11:35 * ;] 
__1. to be strong enough for. 
__2. to ward off. 
__3. to aid, relieve: with dative of person(s), 1 Timothée 5:10 5:16 (mid., WH, mg.).†

G1885.def:
ἐπαρχεία (Rec. -χία, see Bl., § 3, 5), -ας, ἡ 
(ἔπαρχος, a prefect), [in LXX: Esther 4:11 (מְדִינָה), Jdth.3:6 A* ;] 
the jurisdiction of a prefect, a province: Actes 23:3, 34 25:1.†
*†ἐπάρχεισς, -ον, 
of a prefect: ἡ ἐ. (sc. ἐξουσία) = ἐπαρχεια, which see, Actes 25:1 (WH, mg.).†

G1886.def:
ἔπ-αυλις, -εως, ἡ
(αὐλή), [in LXX for חָצֵר, טִירָה, (l.with), etc. ;] 
a dwelling, habitation: Actes 1:20 (LXX).†

G1887.def:
ἐπ-αύριον, 
adv. [in LXX for מָחָר, Genèse 30:33, elsewhere, Exode 9:6, al., for מׇחֳרָת ;] 
on the morrow: in NT, ἡ ἐ. (sc. ἡμέρα), Matthieu 27:62, Marc 11:12, Jean 1:29, Actes 10:9, al

G1888.def:
αὐτόφωρος, -ον
(αὐτός, φώρ, a thief) [in Sm.: Job 34:11 * ;] 
prop. with ref. to theft, then generally, in the very act: as freq., neut. dative after ἐπί, Jean 8:4 (Rec., ἐπαυτοφώρῳ).†

G1890.def:
ἐπ-αφρίζω 
to foam up: metaphorically, τ. αἰσχύνας, Ju 13.†

G1892.def:
ἐπ-εγείρω 
[in LXX for עוּר hi., קוּם hi., etc. ;] 
to rouse up, excite: C. accusative of thing(s), διωγμόν, Actes 13:50; ψυχάς, Actes 14:2.†

G1893.def:
ἐπεί 
conj. (ἐπί, εἰ), 
when, since; 
__1. of time, when, after: Luc 7:1 (Rec., WH, mg.). 
__2. Of cause, since, because: Matthieu 18:32 21:46 27:6, Marc 15:42, Luc 1:34, Jean 13:29 19:31, Actes 13:46 (Rec., WH, mg.), 1 Corinthiens 14:12, 2 Corinthiens 11:18 13:3, Hébreux 5:2, 11 6:13 9:17 11:11; ἐ. οὖν, Hébreux 2:14 4:6. With ellipsis, otherwise, else: Romains 11:6, 22, Hébreux 9:26; ἐ. ἄρα, 1 Corinthiens 5:10 7:14; introducing a question, Romains 3:6, 1 Corinthiens 14:16 15:29, Hébreux 10:2 (cf. 4Ma.1:33 4Mac 2:7 4Mac 2:10 4Mac 4:24-26).†

G1894.def:
ἐπει-δή 
conj.; 
__1. of time, when now, after that: Luc 7:1 (WH, txt.). 
__2. Of cause, seeing that, forasmuch as: Luc 11:6, Actes 13:46 (WH, txt., RV) Actes 14:12 15:24, 1 Corinthiens 1:21-22 14:16 15:21, Philippiens 2:26.†

G1895.def:
ἐπει-δή-περ 
conj., 
forasmuch as ("a stately compound," frequently in cl. and suitable for the formal introduction of Lk): Luc 1:1.†

G1896.def:
ἐπ-εῖδον 2 aor. without Pres. in use; 
[in LXX chiefly for רָאָה ;] to regard with attention, look upon (in cl., of the gods) 
__1. with a view to bless: with inf., Luc 1:25 (cf. DB, 136b). 
__2. To punish: before ἐπί, Actes 4:29.†

G1898.def:
ἐπ-εισ-αγωγή, -ῆς, ἡ 
a bringing in besides or in addition (Hipp., FlJ, al.): Hébreux 7:19 (cf. MM, Exp., xiv).†

G1899.def:
ἐπειτα, adv. of sequence 
[in LXX: Nombres 19:10 A, Ésaïe 16:2, 4Ma.6:3 * ;] 
thereupon, thereafter, then: Luc 16:7, Galates 1:21, Jacques 4:14; before μετὰ τοῦτο, Jean 11:7; μετὰ ἔτη τρία, Galates 1:18; διὰ δεκατεσσάρων ἐτῶν, Galates 2:1; πρῶτον . . . ἔ., 1 Corinthiens 15:46, 1 Thessaloniciens 4:17, Hébreux 7:2; πρότεφον . . . ἔ, Hébreux 7:27; ἀπαρχὴ . . . ἔ., 1 Corinthiens 15:23; εἶτα . . . ἔ., 1 Corinthiens 15:5-6 (WH, txt.); . . . ἔ., 1 Corinthiens 15:5-7 (WH, mg.); τρίτον . . . ἔ. (his), 1 Corinthiens 12:28.†
